relevance_note: Single case report of a woman with a LAMP2 variant and Danon disease: "genetic sequencing revealed a novel frameshift heterozygous mutation (c.764_765insGA) of LAMP2".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short script only assembled the JSON. Scope: proband ('patient', rule 5, as 'the proband' is a role word) plus father, mother, uncle and aunt, who were Sanger tested and did not carry the variant (no variant rows for them). The 6-year-old brother was neither tested ('The patient's family refused echocardiogram and genetic testing for the patient's brother') nor affected, so he gets no row under the scope rule; the paper says he 'had normal development' and no cardiac symptoms. Sex of relatives taken from the relation words (father/mother/uncle/aunt). Uncle and aunt are assumed to be the 'relatives ... all over 50 years old' of the Discussion. Parents' statement 'did not show any cardiac, skeletal muscle, or mental disorder' was recorded as broad excluded features but not used to exclude specific checklist items. Normal IQ (111) recorded as intellectual disability excluded in phenotypic_features, but the composite checklist item (ID, cognitive impairment or learning difficulties) left not reported because learning difficulties are not addressed. Skeletal myopathy checklist item excluded from denial of skeletal muscle symptoms plus normal EMG. No age at onset: only 'in the past few years'. No protein HGVS printed (only 'premature termination to 281-amino-acid residues' and, inconsistently, 'premature termination of protein translation 46 amino acids forward'). Possible tension: title/abstract call the case 'cardiac-only' and the Discussion says she 'only presented with cardiac hypertrophy and preexcitation', while the case report also gives mild myopia and slightly elevated AST/ALT; both recorded as observed. Supplementary Table 1 (proteomics) shows LAMP2 values for controls and patient; used only via the text statement.
